methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $4.04B (to $7.33B) × margin 35.0% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $9.58B
K = capital to build it: $4.04B ÷ sales-to-capital 1.75 = $2.30B
σ = 28% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $7.78B
assets in place = NOPAT $0 ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $7.78B − net debt $941.1M) ÷ 478,965,000 = $14.28
